note: The declared mount set. The T2 tier runs on this list and not on whatever it happens to find, so a face that vanishes is a failure rather than a smaller denominator. Today the list is the fixture set, because the app's own faces are not written yet -- that is a statement about how far the harness has been pointed, not a claim that any face is covered. When faces land they are added here and the fixtures stay, because the fixtures are the pixel tier's live rounds.

faces.role: positive control for the pixel tier
live round: a margin note painted over the row text
live round: a glyph on the replaced-element default
live round: the sheet painted twice
